commitments_terms_match_kind.name: commitments_terms_match_kind
commitments_terms_match_kind.value:
case when "commitments"."kind" = 'pledge' then
      "commitments"."amount_minor" is not null and "commitments"."amount_minor" > 0 and
      "commitments"."currency" is not null and "commitments"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and "commitments"."quantity" is null
    else "commitments"."amount_minor" is null and "commitments"."currency" is null and
      "commitments"."quantity" is not null and "commitments"."quantity" between 1 and 999 end
    and ("commitments"."kind" = 'service_promise' or "commitments"."expected_fulfilment_date" is null)

commitments_verified_status.name: commitments_verified_status
commitments_verified_status.value:
("commitments"."verified_at" is not null) = ("commitments"."status" in ('active', 'purchased', 'fulfilled', 'cancelled'))
    and ("commitments"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("commitments"."status" = 'cancelled')

invitation_response_consistent.name: invitation_response_consistent
invitation_response_consistent.value:
case
      when "invitations"."status" is null then "invitations"."party_size" is null and "invitations"."responded_at" is null and "invitations"."message" is null
      when "invitations"."status" = 'not_attending' then "invitations"."party_size" is not null and "invitations"."party_size" = 0 and "invitations"."responded_at" is not null
      else "invitations"."party_size" is not null and "invitations"."party_size" between 1 and "invitations"."max_party" and "invitations"."responded_at" is not null
    end
    and ("invitations"."message" is null or char_length("invitations"."message") <= 1000)

wishes_quantity_type.name: wishes_quantity_type
wishes_quantity_type.value:
("wishes"."quantity_total" is null or "wishes"."quantity_total" between 1 and 999) and
    case "wishes"."type"
      when 'group_fund' then "wishes"."quantity_total" is null
      when 'service' then "wishes"."description" is not null and char_length(btrim("wishes"."description")) > 0
      when 'open_wish' then ("wishes"."quantity_total" is null) = "wishes"."allow_multiple_commitments"
      else "wishes"."quantity_total" is not null
    end and ("wishes"."type" = 'open_wish' or not "wishes"."allow_multiple_commitments")

wishes_amounts_match_type.name: wishes_amounts_match_type
wishes_amounts_match_type.value:
case when "wishes"."type" = 'group_fund' then
      "wishes"."target_amount_minor" is not null and "wishes"."target_amount_minor" > 0 and
      ("wishes"."minimum_amount_minor" is null or "wishes"."minimum_amount_minor" between 1 and "wishes"."target_amount_minor")
    else "wishes"."target_amount_minor" is null and "wishes"."minimum_amount_minor" is null end
    and ("wishes"."suggested_amount_minor" is null or ("wishes"."type" in ('physical', 'experience') and "wishes"."suggested_amount_minor" > 0))
    and ("wishes"."currency" is not null) = ("wishes"."target_amount_minor" is not null or "wishes"."suggested_amount_minor" is not null)
    and ("wishes"."currency" is null or "wishes"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
